scenarios.when: The user supplies a query and candidate texts and requests a new JSON ranking file.
scenarios.then: Keep exact input texts, use qwen3.7-text-rerank, validate the request and new path before credentials, and invoke rerank once with only --host and --request. Default top_n to all documents.

Keep one-based rank and zero-based original index distinct, preserve raw finite relevance_score and the executor ordering, and save the JSON. A receipt summary may show the same rank/index/score; scores are not probabilities, accuracy or permission for external actions.

scenarios.when: The user asks about reranking or changes only display order or explicit weights on existing scores.
scenarios.then: Explain locally or calculate only the stated formula; no paid rerank, diagnostic calls, invented missing scores or database.

scenarios.when: The query, candidates, request size, top_n or output path violates the bounded contract.
scenarios.then: Stop before credentials and networking. Preserve input and existing files; no automatic truncation, overwriting or expansion into paid batches. Cross-batch scores are not a validated global ranking.

scenarios.when: The bound host returns a local connection or credential-adapter failure.
scenarios.then: Stop without init, doctor, models, another host, credential or fallback transport. Explicit recheck or new verified evidence permits one relevant check on the same host only.

scenarios.when: A request times out, has no valid receipt or cannot be validated, or an accepted result cannot be written and verified.
scenarios.then: Preserve unknown, or accepted with output_verified=false for output failure. Do not poll, retry, use Jev/chat or claim no charge; explain possible billing before an explicitly authorized repeat.

scenarios.when: The user asks for currently visible rerank models.
scenarios.then: Run models kind=rerank once against GET /v1/models and intersect with qwen3.7-text-rerank. Visibility does not prove route, permission, billing or real-host acceptance and is not an ordinary rerank preflight.
